scripts:
create service user wknd-seo-bulk-service with path system/wknd

set ACL for wknd-seo-bulk-service
  allow jcr:read on /content
  allow jcr:read,jcr:write,jcr:nodeTypeManagement,jcr:addChildNodes on /content/wknd
  allow jcr:read,jcr:write,jcr:nodeTypeManagement,jcr:addChildNodes on /var/wknd/seo/jobs
end

create path (sling:Folder) /var/wknd
create path (sling:Folder) /var/wknd/seo
create path (sling:Folder) /var/wknd/seo/jobs
